title: Derived etale module pullback has the stalk at the image point
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $u:U\to T$ any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $\bar v:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to U$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. On the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], use the constant-coefficient module inverse image $u^*$ with $u^{-1}A_T\cong A_U$ and its exactness as in [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. Use the unbounded derived categories of [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and the geometric stalks of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Write $D(u^*)$ for the functor induced by applying $u^*$ termwise, and $D(s_{\bar w})$ for the functor induced by the exact module stalk at a geometric point $\bar w$. There is a natural isomorphism of functors to $D(A)$
$$ D(s_{\bar v})\circ D(u^*)\ \cong\ D(s_{u\circ\bar v}). $$
For a representing complex $C$, this isomorphism is represented by the degreewise canonical inverse-image stalk comparisons
$$ (u^*C^n)_{\bar v}\xrightarrow{\sim} C^n_{u\circ\bar v}. $$
These maps are additive and $A$-linear and commute with the differentials and all morphisms of complexes; the displayed derived isomorphism is their descent through localization at quasi-isomorphisms. No boundedness, finiteness or hypothesis on $u$ beyond being a scheme morphism is imposed.

source.place: Tag 03Q1 (lemma-stalk-pullback), clauses (1) and (3), extended termwise to unbounded constant-coefficient module complexes and localized at quasi-isomorphisms
